svg.title: AWS Studio refactor readiness: the 23 steps before the 1.0 boundary refactor
svg.desc: Framework code is copied into every project today, so it can't be fixed after release. The fix moves it into the versioned package, but some choices become permanent at 1.0. Before refactoring, 23 steps protect the starting point, start the name clearance, record a baseline, prove what works, record the decisions only the owner can make, map dependencies and list what becomes permanent, then hand off to a prompt generator. Six steps are gates: 3, 8, 15, 16, 18 and 22. Each step shows why it exists and what it produces.
